mapper.sql: session_id, profile_id, caller_number, channel_type, biz_type, biz_id, biz_title, start_time, end_time, active_flag, last_heartbeat, expire_time, active_owner, create_time
mapper.insert: insert ignore into ai_unified_session (profile_id, caller_number, channel_type, biz_type, biz_id, biz_title, start_time, end_time, create_time) values (#{profileId}, #{callerNumber}, #{channelType}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{bizTitle}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, sysdate())

insert into ai_unified_session (profile_id, caller_number, channel_type, biz_type, biz_id, biz_title, start_time, active_flag, last_heartbeat, expire_time, create_time) values (#{profileId}, #{callerNumber}, #{channelType}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{bizTitle}, #{startTime}, '1', #{lastHeartbeat}, #{expireTime}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select from ai_unified_session where active_owner = #{activeOwner} and active_flag = '1' limit 1
select from ai_unified_session where profile_id = #{profileId} and active_flag = '1' order by start_time desc
select from ai_unified_session where caller_number = #{callerNumber} and active_flag = '1' order by start_time desc

select session_id, profile_id, caller_number, channel_type, biz_type, biz_id, biz_title, start_time, end_time, create_time from ai_unified_session where profile_id = #{profileId} order by start_time desc limit 100

select session_id, profile_id, caller_number, channel_type, biz_type, biz_id, biz_title, start_time, end_time, create_time from ai_unified_session where caller_number = #{callerNumber} order by start_time desc limit 100
